options.content: GitHub and DevLake prove PR/check events. They do **not** prove an off-platform substantive review. #2866 is a merge-on-green control, not a review-time sample. Missing agent boundaries remain missing until a SHA-bound event is appended.

panels.title: Governed projection identity
panels.description: Current singleton identity for the governed delivery-agent-event projection. Frozen v1 ledger SHA-256 is the cutover JSONL bytes; complete replay SHA-256 covers frozen v1 plus accepted batches. Missing state or v2 identity fields display as unknown. The dashboard time range does not filter this state view.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(s.source_commit_sha, 'unknown') AS `Source commit`, COALESCE(s.projector_version, 'unknown') AS `Projector version`, COALESCE(s.generation, 'unknown') AS `Generation`, COALESCE(s.event_count, 'unknown') AS `Events`, COALESCE(s.projected_at, 'unknown') AS `Projected (UTC)`, COALESCE(s.ledger_sha256, 'unknown') AS `Frozen v1 ledger SHA-256`, COALESCE(i.replay_sha256, 'unknown') AS `Complete replay SHA-256`, COALESCE(i.batch_manifest_sha256, 'unknown') AS `Batch manifest SHA-256` FROM (SELECT 'delivery-agent-events/v1' AS projection_id) AS p LEFT JOIN waaseyaa_delivery_projection_state AS s ON s.projection_id = p.projection_id LEFT JOIN waaseyaa_delivery_projection_identity_v2 AS i ON i.projection_id = p.projection_id

panels.title: K1 pull-request timeline
panels.description: Pull requests in the selected pull-request creation-time cohort for waaseyaa/framework.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.number AS `PR`, p.state AS `Status`, p.github_created_at AS `Submitted (UTC)`, p.merged_at AS `Merged (UTC)`, ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, p.github_created_at, COALESCE(p.merged_at, UTC_TIMESTAMP())) / 3600, 2) AS `Open hours`, LEFT(p.head_commit_sha, 12) AS `Head SHA` FROM _tool_github_pull_requests p INNER JOIN _tool_github_repos repo ON repo.connection_id = p.connection_id AND repo.github_id = p.repo_id WHERE repo.full_name = 'waaseyaa/framework' AND $__timeFilter(p.github_created_at) ORDER BY p.number

panels.title: GitHub-native review evidence by exact head
panels.description: GitHub-native review evidence for waaseyaa/framework pull requests in the selected pull-request creation-time cohort.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.number AS `PR`, SUM(CASE WHEN r.commit_sha = p.head_commit_sha THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Current-head reviews`, SUM(CASE WHEN r.github_id IS NOT NULL AND r.commit_sha <> p.head_commit_sha THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS `Superseded-head reviews`, MIN(CASE WHEN r.commit_sha = p.head_commit_sha THEN r.github_submit_at END) AS `First current-head review (UTC)`, LEFT(p.head_commit_sha, 12) AS `Current head` FROM _tool_github_pull_requests p INNER JOIN _tool_github_repos repo ON repo.connection_id = p.connection_id AND repo.github_id = p.repo_id LEFT JOIN _tool_github_pull_request_reviews r ON r.connection_id = p.connection_id AND r.pull_request_id = p.github_id WHERE repo.full_name = 'waaseyaa/framework' AND $__timeFilter(p.github_created_at) GROUP BY p.number, p.head_commit_sha ORDER BY p.number

panels.title: Recent CI pipelines
panels.description: CI runs in the selected run creation-time cohort for waaseyaa/framework.

targets.rawSql: SELECT run.display_title AS `Run`, run.status AS `Status`, run.conclusion AS `Result`, run.run_started_at AS `Started (UTC)`, ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, run.run_started_at, run.github_updated_at) / 60, 1) AS `Minutes`, LEFT(run.head_sha, 12) AS `Head SHA` FROM _tool_github_runs run INNER JOIN _tool_github_repos repo ON repo.connection_id = run.connection_id AND repo.github_id = run.repo_id WHERE repo.full_name = 'waaseyaa/framework' AND $__timeFilter(run.github_created_at) ORDER BY run.github_created_at DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Time to first substantive review (agent-event authority)
panels.description: First known timed substantive review for each waaseyaa/framework pull request in the selected pull-request creation-time cohort. The earliest review may occur outside the selected pull-request creation window.

targets.rawSql: SELECT p.number AS `PR`, MIN(e.occurred_at_utc) AS `First substantive review (UTC)`, ROUND(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, p.github_created_at, MIN(e.occurred_at_utc)) / 60000000, 2) AS `Minutes from submission`, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(e.evidence_kind ORDER BY e.occurred_at_utc, e.source_ordinal SEPARATOR ','), ',', 1) AS `Evidence` FROM _tool_github_pull_requests p INNER JOIN _tool_github_repos repo ON repo.connection_id = p.connection_id AND repo.github_id = p.repo_id LEFT JOIN waaseyaa_delivery_agent_events_v1 e ON e.repository = repo.full_name AND e.pull_request = p.number AND e.event_type = 'substantive_review_issued' AND e.occurred_at_utc IS NOT NULL WHERE repo.full_name = 'waaseyaa/framework' AND $__timeFilter(p.github_created_at) GROUP BY p.number, p.github_created_at ORDER BY p.number

panels.title: Append-only agent events
panels.description: Latest 50 governed agent events by source order across the complete projection; the dashboard time range does not filter this current evidence view.

targets.rawSql: SELECT pull_request AS `PR`, event_type AS `Event`, occurred_at_utc AS `Occurred (UTC)`, recorded_at_utc AS `Recorded (UTC)`, actor_kind AS `Actor`, review_depth AS `Depth`, outcome AS `Outcome`, finding_count AS `Findings`, evidence_kind AS `Evidence`, LEFT(head_sha, 12) AS `Head SHA` FROM waaseyaa_delivery_agent_events_v1 ORDER BY source_ordinal DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Verifier findings and adjudication
panels.description: Latest 50 governed verifier findings by source order with their current adjudication state; the dashboard time range does not filter this current evidence view.

targets.rawSql: SELECT f.pull_request AS `PR`, f.verifier_id AS `Verifier`, f.check_type AS `Check type`, f.claim_text AS `Claim`, f.observed_text AS `Observed`, COALESCE(a.adjudication_classification, 'pending') AS `Adjudication`, a.candidate_defect_confirmed AS `Candidate defect?`, f.safety_effect AS `Safety effect`, f.elapsed_ms AS `Cost ms`, LEFT(f.head_sha, 12) AS `Head SHA` FROM waaseyaa_delivery_agent_events_v1 f LEFT JOIN waaseyaa_delivery_agent_events_v1 a ON a.causation_event_id = f.event_id AND a.event_type = 'verification_finding_adjudicated' WHERE f.event_type = 'verification_finding_issued' ORDER BY f.source_ordinal DESC LIMIT 50
